notes:
Open any supported file directly, and floating windows that stay where you put them.

### New
- Open accepts CAD and mesh files (3DM, STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, 3MF, DXF) as well as projects: they open as a new document, after asking to save your changes.

### Improved
- Objects, Selection sets, Groups, Blocks and Saved views all reopen where you left them, also after a restart, and always stay inside the screen. Double-click a window's title bar to put it back in its default place.
- A single CAD or mesh file dropped on an empty document opens it directly.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
